build_seq2seq_model: build a Seq2seqAgent model with configurable hidden size, embedding size, and number of layers
configure_seq2seq_attention: configure the Seq2seqAgent with concat, general, dot, or local attention mechanisms
train_seq2seq_agent: train a Seq2seqAgent using TorchGeneratorAgent with greedy decoding or beam search
load_seq2seq_model: load a saved Seq2seqAgent model state dict from a file path using torch.load
validate_seq2seq_observation: validate an observation with text_vec to check for empty input sequences before training
